meaning:
ἐμ-πίπρημι,
ἐμπρήθω (for the form, see: ἐμπίπλημι, and cf. Veitch, see word πίμπρημι), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף ;]
to set on fire: πόλιν, Mat.22:7; pass., of the body, to become inflamed: Act.28:6 (T; πίμπρημι WH, which see).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
